repl.description: Start an interactive NestJS REPL for Meanderaw services

start.description: Run the Meanderaw application. With no arguments (or --args="--check") it is read-only: it regenerates the whole sweep — the lattice's unit space, enumerated and classified, then the historical corpus's hardcoded Codes beyond that budget — into a throwaway database and fails if it disagrees with the committed output/meanders.sqlite. Nothing writes that database without --write: --args="--write" clears its meander rows and regenerates the sweep into it, and --args="--write --rows <n> --columns <n> --code <code>" writes that one row; --check with --write, or --code without --write, exits non-zero. `guard-code` depends on this target, and there are deliberately no configurations: `guard-code`'s own --configuration (check or write) and a bare `guard-code` all reach this target with no matching configuration, so every one of them runs the read-only default. A `write` configuration here would be forwarded by `guard-code:write` and rewrite the committed database as a side effect. `build` compiles this project rather than drawing anything, so populating the database is this target's job.
